major-00.name: The Fool
major-00.upright: You stand at the start of something new. Trust your curiosity and take the first step, even without a full map. Openness and a light heart serve you better than overplanning right now.
major-00.reversed: A leap may be more reckless than brave. Check what you are overlooking before you jump, or notice whether fear of looking foolish is keeping you from beginning at all.

yesNoNote.upright: A fresh start favors you. Take the step.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not yet. Look harder before you leap.

major-01.name: The Magician
major-01.upright: You have the tools, skills, and energy you need. Focus your intention and act. What you put your mind to can take real shape now.
major-01.reversed: Your talents may be scattered or misdirected. Watch for manipulation, in others or in yourself, and reconnect your actions with your honest aims.

yesNoNote.upright: You have what it takes to make this happen.
yesNoNote.reversed: Something in the plan or the people is off. Hold back.

major-02.name: The High Priestess
major-02.upright: The answer is not on the surface. Quiet down and listen to your intuition; some things reveal themselves only when you stop pushing for them.
major-02.reversed: You may be ignoring your inner voice or hiding things from yourself. Secrets or missing information cloud the picture until you look within.

yesNoNote.upright: The outcome is still hidden. Trust your gut more than a firm answer.
yesNoNote.reversed: Hidden facts or unclear motives. Don't commit yet.

major-03.name: The Empress
major-03.upright: Growth comes naturally when you care for it. This is a time for comfort, creativity, and generosity, toward others and toward yourself.
major-03.reversed: You may be neglecting your own needs or smothering something that needs space. Creative energy feels blocked until you rest and reconnect with what nourishes you.

yesNoNote.upright: Conditions are fertile. What you tend will grow.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once you give it, and yourself, more care.

major-04.name: The Emperor
major-04.upright: Order and steady leadership bring results. Set clear boundaries, make a plan, and take responsibility; firm foundations make the rest possible.
major-04.reversed: Control may have become rigid, or structure is missing altogether. Notice where power is being misused, or where you need to claim more authority over your own life.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, with a clear plan and firm commitment.
yesNoNote.reversed: Too rigid or too chaotic right now. Not as things stand.

major-05.name: The Hierophant
major-05.upright: Established paths, mentors, and shared traditions can guide you. Learning the rules, and why they exist, helps you move forward with support.
major-05.reversed: Conventional wisdom may not fit your situation. You are being asked to question inherited beliefs and find your own way, even if it breaks from expectation.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if you follow the proven path or trusted advice.
yesNoNote.reversed: Only if you are willing to go your own way.

major-06.name: The Lovers
major-06.upright: A meaningful connection or an important choice is before you. Choose in line with your deepest values; harmony comes from alignment, not from losing yourself.
major-06.reversed: Imbalance or disconnection in a relationship, or a choice made against your values. Honest conversation, with others or with yourself, helps restore alignment.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if the choice matches what you truly value.
yesNoNote.reversed: Something is out of alignment. Not right now.

major-07.name: The Chariot
major-07.upright: Drive and discipline carry you forward. Hold opposing forces in check, keep your eyes on the goal, and you can make real progress.
major-07.reversed: You may feel pulled in different directions or stalled. Regain your direction before pushing harder; force without focus gets you nowhere.

yesNoNote.upright: Push forward with focus and you will get there.
yesNoNote.reversed: No clear direction yet. Regroup first.

major-08.name: Strength
major-08.upright: Quiet courage wins here. Meet challenges with patience and gentleness rather than force; your steadiness is more powerful than it looks.
major-08.reversed: Self-doubt or frayed nerves may be getting the better of you. Be kind to yourself and rebuild your confidence before taking on more.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Patience and courage see you through.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once you feel steadier in yourself.

major-09.name: The Hermit
major-09.upright: Step back from the noise. Time alone for reflection will show you what matters; the light you need is the one you already carry.
major-09.reversed: Withdrawal may have turned into isolation, or you are avoiding the reflection you need. Look for a balance between solitude and reaching out.

yesNoNote.upright: Not yet clear. Take time to reflect before deciding.
yesNoNote.reversed: Avoiding the question won't help. Not as things stand.

major-10.name: Wheel of Fortune
major-10.upright: Circumstances are shifting, often in your favor. Ride the turn with an open mind; things are moving into a new phase.
major-10.reversed: A run of bad luck, or resistance to change. What is out of your control is shifting anyway, so focus on how you respond.

yesNoNote.upright: The wheel is turning your way.
yesNoNote.reversed: The timing is against you for now.

major-11.name: Justice
major-11.upright: Fairness and honesty prevail. Decisions made now carry consequences, so weigh the facts clearly and act with integrity.
major-11.reversed: Something may be unfair or unbalanced, or you are avoiding accountability. Look honestly at your own part and at what is not being said.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if your cause is fair and honest.
yesNoNote.reversed: Something is unbalanced or untrue. No.

major-12.name: The Hanged Man
major-12.upright: Progress may be on hold, but the pause has value. Stop forcing an outcome and look at the situation from a different angle.
major-12.reversed: You may be stalling, or making sacrifices that lead nowhere. Decide whether to wait with purpose or to move on.

yesNoNote.upright: Not yet. A pause and a new view come first.
yesNoNote.reversed: Waiting longer won't change things. No.

major-13.name: Death
major-13.upright: Something is coming to a natural end so that something new can begin. Release what is finished; this is transformation, not catastrophe.
major-13.reversed: You may be holding on to what has already ended. Resisting change prolongs the discomfort, while letting go opens the way forward.

yesNoNote.upright: Not in its current form. Something must end first.
yesNoNote.reversed: Holding on blocks the change you need. No.

major-14.name: Temperance
major-14.upright: Balance and patience bring the best results. Blend different elements thoughtfully and avoid extremes; steady progress is still progress.
major-14.reversed: Excess or imbalance is throwing things off. Slow down, notice where you are overdoing it, and restore a rhythm you can sustain.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, with patience and a balanced approach.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once you restore some balance.

major-15.name: The Devil
major-15.upright: You may feel bound by habits, desires, or situations that don't serve you. Look closely: the chains are often looser than they seem.
major-15.reversed: You are beginning to see through what has held you back. Breaking free takes honesty, but release is within reach.

yesNoNote.upright: This may tie you to something unhealthy. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, if you let go of what holds you back.

major-16.name: The Tower
major-16.upright: Unexpected change shakes what you thought was solid. It is unsettling, but what falls was built on weak foundations, and the truth it reveals frees you.
major-16.reversed: You may be avoiding a necessary upheaval or living in the aftermath of one. Facing the change directly is easier than delaying it.

yesNoNote.upright: Sudden upheaval. Not as you hope.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, but only after facing an uncomfortable truth.

major-17.name: The Star
major-17.upright: After difficulty comes calm and renewal. Your hope is justified; trust the path, take care of yourself, and let inspiration guide you.
major-17.reversed: Discouragement may be dimming your sense of possibility. Reconnect with small sources of hope and with faith in yourself.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. There is real reason for hope.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, if you keep faith a little longer.

major-18.name: The Moon
major-18.upright: Things are not as clear as they seem. Fears and illusions can distort the picture, so move carefully and let intuition guide you through the uncertainty.
major-18.reversed: Confusion is starting to lift and hidden things are coming to light. Trust what you can now see clearly and release fears that have no basis.

yesNoNote.upright: Too much is unclear to say yes. Wait.
yesNoNote.reversed: Clarity is coming. Ask again once you know more.

major-19.name: The Sun
major-19.upright: Warmth, success, and clarity shine on you. This is a time of confidence and joy, so share it freely.
major-19.reversed: Happiness may be dimmed by doubt or delays, or you are struggling to see the bright side. The good is still there; it may just take longer.

yesNoNote.upright: A clear, bright yes.
yesNoNote.reversed: Likely in time, though not as quickly as you'd like.

major-20.name: Judgement
major-20.upright: A moment of clarity calls you to rise and answer. Reflect honestly on the past, forgive what you can, and step into a renewed sense of purpose.
major-20.reversed: Self-doubt or harsh self-judgment may be keeping you from a calling. Listen to the inner summons rather than the inner critic.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. It is time to answer the call.
yesNoNote.reversed: Self-doubt is in the way. Not yet.

major-21.name: The World
major-21.upright: A cycle reaches its fulfilling conclusion. Celebrate what you have accomplished; you are ready for the next chapter.
major-21.reversed: Something feels unfinished, or you are seeking closure that hasn't come. Tie up loose ends before moving on.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Completion and success.
yesNoNote.reversed: Almost. Finish what is still open first.

wands-01.name: Ace of Wands
wands-01.upright: A spark of inspiration or a new opportunity arrives. Energy and enthusiasm are high, so act on the idea while it is fresh.
wands-01.reversed: The spark is there but hard to catch. Delays, low motivation, or false starts suggest waiting until your energy and direction line up.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Seize the new spark.
yesNoNote.reversed: The energy isn't there yet. Not now.

wands-02.name: Two of Wands
wands-02.upright: You are looking beyond where you stand and weighing your options. Plan boldly; the world is larger than your current circumstances.
wands-02.reversed: Fear of the unknown may keep you in familiar territory. Unclear plans or hesitation stall progress until you commit to a direction.

yesNoNote.upright: Likely, once you commit to a plan.
yesNoNote.reversed: Hesitation is holding things up. Not yet.

wands-03.name: Three of Wands
wands-03.upright: Your efforts are underway and early results are on the horizon. Keep looking ahead and be ready to grow beyond your first plans.
wands-03.reversed: Progress is slower than expected, or obstacles you didn't foresee appear. Review your plans and stay patient while things develop.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. What you set in motion is coming back to you.
yesNoNote.reversed: Delays likely. Possibly, but later than hoped.

wands-04.name: Four of Wands
wands-04.upright: A milestone is worth celebrating. Home, community, and stability come together in a moment of shared joy.
wands-04.reversed: Harmony at home or in a group feels shaky, or a celebration is postponed. The foundation is still there; it just needs attention.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. A happy, settled outcome.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, after some tension is resolved.

wands-05.name: Five of Wands
wands-05.upright: Competing ideas or egos create friction. The struggle can sharpen you, but make sure the fight is worth having.
wands-05.reversed: Conflict may be easing, or you are avoiding a necessary disagreement. Look for common ground instead of keeping score.

yesNoNote.upright: Too much conflict around this. Not easily.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, if the competing sides find common ground.

wands-06.name: Six of Wands
wands-06.upright: Your efforts are noticed and rewarded. Enjoy the recognition and let success build your confidence.
wands-06.reversed: Recognition is delayed, or you are leaning too much on others' approval. Measure success by your own standards.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Success and recognition.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not the win you want right now.

wands-07.name: Seven of Wands
wands-07.upright: You hold an advantage but must defend it. Stand firm in what you believe; persistence keeps you on higher ground.
wands-07.reversed: You may feel overwhelmed or tempted to give up your position. Decide which battles truly matter and let the rest go.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if you hold your ground.
yesNoNote.reversed: You may be stretched too thin. Not as things stand.

wands-08.name: Eight of Wands
wands-08.upright: Things move quickly. News, travel, or sudden progress arrive fast, so keep up and act while momentum is with you.
wands-08.reversed: Delays, crossed wires, or rushing ahead cause frustration. Slow down enough to aim before the next move.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, and soon.
yesNoNote.reversed: Delays or haste get in the way. Not now.

wands-09.name: Nine of Wands
wands-09.upright: You are tired but close to the finish. Draw on your resilience for one more push, and protect what you have built.
wands-09.reversed: Exhaustion or suspicion may be wearing you down. Rest, ask for help, and don't treat everyone as a threat.

yesNoNote.upright: Possibly. Keep going; you are nearly there.
yesNoNote.reversed: You are running on empty. Not without rest.

wands-10.name: Ten of Wands
wands-10.upright: You are carrying too much. Success may have brought extra burdens; see what you can delegate or set down.
wands-10.reversed: The load is starting to lighten, or you are finally letting go of what isn't yours to carry. Ask for help without guilt.

yesNoNote.upright: Not without taking on too much. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once you put some of the load down.

wands-11.name: Page of Wands
wands-11.upright: A curious, eager energy invites you to explore. Try something new without needing to know where it leads.
wands-11.reversed: Enthusiasm fizzles before it becomes action, or ideas lack direction. Pick one spark and give it some follow-through.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Explore it with an open mind.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not until the idea has more direction.

wands-12.name: Knight of Wands
wands-12.upright: Bold action and passion drive you forward. Charge ahead with confidence, but keep an eye on where you are going.
wands-12.reversed: Impulsiveness or impatience may lead to rushed mistakes. Channel your energy before it burns out or scatters.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Go for it boldly.
yesNoNote.reversed: Too hasty right now. Slow down first.

wands-13.name: Queen of Wands
wands-13.upright: Confidence and warmth make you a natural leader. Be yourself fully; your energy and determination inspire others.
wands-13.reversed: Self-doubt, jealousy, or burnout may dim your light. Reclaim your confidence by focusing on what you genuinely enjoy.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Step forward with confidence.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once you trust yourself again.

wands-14.name: King of Wands
wands-14.upright: You see the bigger picture and can lead others toward it. Act with vision and decisiveness, and take ownership of the result.
wands-14.reversed: Ambition may be turning into impatience or domineering behavior. Lead by example rather than by force.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Lead with vision and it will happen.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not if pushed through by force alone.

cups-01.name: Ace of Cups
cups-01.upright: Your heart opens to new love, friendship, or emotional renewal. Let yourself receive as well as give; feelings flow freely now.
cups-01.reversed: Emotions may be blocked or held back, or you are pouring out more than you take in. Make space to feel what you feel.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. An open-hearted beginning.
yesNoNote.reversed: Your heart isn't fully in it yet. Not now.

cups-02.name: Two of Cups
cups-02.upright: A balanced, mutual connection forms. Whether in love, friendship, or work, this is a meeting of equals built on respect.
cups-02.reversed: A relationship feels out of balance, or communication has broken down. Honest, kind conversation can restore the bond.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. The feeling is mutual.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not while the connection is out of balance.

cups-03.name: Three of Cups
cups-03.upright: Friendship and shared joy lift your spirits. Gather with people who support you and celebrate together.
cups-03.reversed: Social tension, gossip, or overindulgence spoil the mood, or you feel left out. Reconnect with the friends who truly matter.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. A reason to celebrate.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, if group tensions settle.

cups-04.name: Four of Cups
cups-04.upright: You may feel bored or withdrawn, focused on what is lacking. Look up: an offer or opportunity may be right in front of you.
cups-04.reversed: You are coming out of a rut and ready to engage again. New interest and motivation return when you let them.

yesNoNote.upright: Your heart isn't in it right now. Not yet.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly. You are ready to say yes to something new.

cups-05.name: Five of Cups
cups-05.upright: Disappointment or loss weighs on you. Grieve what is gone, but notice that not everything has spilled; something remains.
cups-05.reversed: You are beginning to accept the past and look toward what is still possible. Healing starts when you turn around.

yesNoNote.upright: Disappointment around this. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, as you move past what was lost.

cups-06.name: Six of Cups
cups-06.upright: Memories and simple kindness bring comfort. Someone or something from the past may return, or you rediscover a childlike joy.
cups-06.reversed: Living in the past may keep you from the present. Honor old memories, then turn your attention to what is here now.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, especially if it reconnects you with something good.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not if it means going backward.

cups-07.name: Seven of Cups
cups-07.upright: Many options shimmer before you, but not all are real. Separate wishful thinking from what is actually achievable before you choose.
cups-07.reversed: Clarity returns and you see which options matter. Commit to one path instead of keeping every door open.

yesNoNote.upright: Too many illusions to say yes. Look closer.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, now that you see things more clearly.

cups-08.name: Eight of Cups
cups-08.upright: Something no longer fulfills you, and it is time to move on. Walking away takes courage, but you are seeking something deeper.
cups-08.reversed: You may be torn between staying and leaving, or drifting without purpose. Be honest about what you truly want.

yesNoNote.upright: Not here. It is time to move on.
yesNoNote.reversed: Unclear. Decide what you are really looking for.

cups-09.name: Nine of Cups
cups-09.upright: Often called the wish card: what you hoped for is within reach. Enjoy the satisfaction and let yourself feel grateful.
cups-09.reversed: A wish may come true but feel hollow, or smugness creeps in. Ask what would bring you real, lasting contentment.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Your wish is likely granted.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, but it may not satisfy you as expected.

cups-10.name: Ten of Cups
cups-10.upright: Emotional fulfillment and harmony with the people you love. This is a picture of lasting happiness and belonging.
cups-10.reversed: Family tensions or unmet ideals disturb the peace. Let go of the picture-perfect version and value the real connections you have.

yesNoNote.upright: A warm, happy yes.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, after some repair in your relationships.

cups-11.name: Page of Cups
cups-11.upright: A gentle, imaginative message arrives. Stay open to creative ideas, sweet surprises, and your own tender feelings.
cups-11.reversed: Emotional immaturity, moodiness, or creative blocks get in the way. Be patient with yourself and with your feelings.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. A pleasant surprise is likely.
yesNoNote.reversed: Feelings are too unsettled. Not yet.

cups-12.name: Knight of Cups
cups-12.upright: A romantic or idealistic offer comes your way. Follow your heart, but keep your feet on the ground.
cups-12.reversed: Moodiness, unrealistic expectations, or empty promises cloud things. Look for actions that match the words.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Follow your heart.
yesNoNote.reversed: The promise may not be real. Not now.

cups-13.name: Queen of Cups
cups-13.upright: Compassion and emotional wisdom guide you. Trust your intuition and offer care to others, and to yourself.
cups-13.reversed: You may be absorbing too much of others' emotions, or neglecting your own. Set gentle boundaries and refill your cup.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if it feels right in your heart.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once you care for your own needs first.

cups-14.name: King of Cups
cups-14.upright: You can stay calm and kind even when emotions run high. Lead with steady compassion and balanced judgment.
cups-14.reversed: Emotions may be suppressed or swinging. Find a healthy outlet instead of bottling things up or lashing out.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Stay calm and it works out.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not until emotions are steadier.

swords-01.name: Ace of Swords
swords-01.upright: A breakthrough of clarity cuts through confusion. Speak the truth plainly and act on the insight while it is sharp.
swords-01.reversed: Confused thinking or miscommunication blurs the picture. Gather the facts before deciding, and choose your words with care.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. The way forward is clear.
yesNoNote.reversed: Too much confusion for a clear yes. Not yet.

swords-02.name: Two of Swords
swords-02.upright: You are stuck between two options and may be avoiding the decision. Remove the blindfold: look honestly at what each choice means.
swords-02.reversed: Pressure builds and the stalemate can't last. Information you were avoiding comes out, and a choice must be made.

yesNoNote.upright: Undecided. You need to see more clearly first.
yesNoNote.reversed: A decision is coming soon. It could go either way.

swords-03.name: Three of Swords
swords-03.upright: A painful truth or heartache hurts. Let yourself feel it; acknowledging the hurt is the first step toward healing.
swords-03.reversed: The worst of the pain is passing. You are beginning to recover, forgive, and release what hurt you.

yesNoNote.upright: This brings hurt. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, as healing begins.

swords-04.name: Four of Swords
swords-04.upright: Rest is needed before the next step. Step back, recover your strength, and let your mind quiet down.
swords-04.reversed: You may be pushing on without enough rest, or slowly re-entering the world after a break. Return at a pace you can sustain.

yesNoNote.upright: Not now. Rest first, then ask again.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, as you return refreshed.

swords-05.name: Five of Swords
swords-05.upright: A conflict may be won at too high a cost. Ask whether being right is worth what it does to your relationships.
swords-05.reversed: The urge to make peace grows after a clash. Let go of resentment, and walk away from fights that can't be won fairly.

yesNoNote.upright: Any win here may cost too much. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, if you are willing to make peace.

swords-06.name: Six of Swords
swords-06.upright: You are leaving a difficult time behind for calmer waters. The change may be bittersweet, but it leads somewhere better.
swords-06.reversed: Moving on feels hard, or old troubles follow you. Unfinished business may need attention before you can travel lightly.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Things are improving as you move forward.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not until you deal with what you're carrying.

swords-07.name: Seven of Swords
swords-07.upright: Someone may not be acting openly, possibly you. Be strategic, but be honest with yourself about what you are avoiding.
swords-07.reversed: Secrets come to light, or you feel the weight of not being straight with someone. Coming clean frees you.

yesNoNote.upright: Something isn't being said openly. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once the truth comes out.

swords-08.name: Eight of Swords
swords-08.upright: You feel trapped, but the bonds are looser than they look. Fear and limiting beliefs may be the main thing holding you back.
swords-08.reversed: You are starting to see a way out. Releasing old fears gives you room to move and choose again.

yesNoNote.upright: Not while you feel stuck like this.
yesNoNote.reversed: Yes. You are freeing yourself.

swords-09.name: Nine of Swords
swords-09.upright: Worry and racing thoughts feel overwhelming, especially at night. The fear is real, but often bigger in your mind than in reality; reach out to someone you trust.
swords-09.reversed: Anxiety begins to ease as you talk it through or see things more clearly. Hope returns when you stop facing it alone.

yesNoNote.upright: Worry clouds this question. Not now.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, as your fears ease.

swords-10.name: Ten of Swords
swords-10.upright: A painful chapter reaches its end. It may feel like rock bottom, but the only way from here is up, and the dawn is already coming.
swords-10.reversed: You are recovering from a hard ending and slowly getting back on your feet. Don't reopen old wounds; let them heal.

yesNoNote.upright: This chapter is over. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not yet, but recovery has begun.

swords-11.name: Page of Swords
swords-11.upright: A sharp, curious mind looks for answers. Ask questions, learn eagerly, and stay alert to what is really going on.
swords-11.reversed: Words may come out sharper than intended, or gossip and hasty talk cause trouble. Think before you speak.

yesNoNote.upright: Possibly. Get the facts first.
yesNoNote.reversed: Careless words could spoil this. Not now.

swords-12.name: Knight of Swords
swords-12.upright: You charge ahead with ideas and determination. Act decisively, but make sure speed doesn't trample others along the way.
swords-12.reversed: Haste and bluntness lead to mistakes or hurt feelings. Slow down and consider the consequences before rushing in.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, and quickly, if you stay focused.
yesNoNote.reversed: Rushing in will backfire. No.

swords-13.name: Queen of Swords
swords-13.upright: Clear judgment and honest words serve you. Set firm boundaries and trust your own perspective, informed by experience.
swords-13.reversed: Coldness or harsh judgment may push others away. Balance honesty with compassion, for others and for yourself.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if you see it clearly and honestly.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, with a gentler approach.

swords-14.name: King of Swords
swords-14.upright: Reason and fairness lead the way. Make decisions based on facts and principles, and communicate them clearly.
swords-14.reversed: Intellect may be used to control or manipulate, or logic has lost touch with feeling. Question harsh rules and hidden agendas.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if the facts support it.
yesNoNote.reversed: Something isn't fair or clear. No.

pentacles-01.name: Ace of Pentacles
pentacles-01.upright: A practical opportunity appears: a new job, project, or resource with real potential. Plant the seed and tend it with care.
pentacles-01.reversed: An opportunity may slip by, or plans lack a solid footing. Check the practical details before you commit.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. A solid, promising start.
yesNoNote.reversed: The foundation isn't ready. Not yet.

pentacles-02.name: Two of Pentacles
pentacles-02.upright: You are juggling several demands at once. Stay flexible and keep things moving, but know your priorities.
pentacles-02.reversed: You may be overcommitted and starting to drop things. Simplify, say no where you can, and restore some balance.

yesNoNote.upright: Possibly, if you can keep everything in balance.
yesNoNote.reversed: Too much on your plate for this right now.

pentacles-03.name: Three of Pentacles
pentacles-03.upright: Good work comes from collaboration and skill. Share your expertise, listen to others, and build something solid together.
pentacles-03.reversed: Poor teamwork, unclear roles, or sloppy effort undermine the project. Get everyone aligned before going further.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, especially with the right people involved.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not until the team is working together.

pentacles-04.name: Four of Pentacles
pentacles-04.upright: You want to hold tight to what you have. Security matters, but too tight a grip can keep good things from coming in.
pentacles-04.reversed: You are loosening your grip, for better or worse. Find the middle ground between letting go and losing control.

yesNoNote.upright: Possibly, if you are willing to loosen your grip.
yesNoNote.reversed: Unsteady ground. Proceed with care.

pentacles-05.name: Five of Pentacles
pentacles-05.upright: Hard times or a sense of being left out in the cold. Help may be closer than you think; don't be too proud to accept it.
pentacles-05.reversed: Things are starting to recover after a difficult stretch. Support and stability return little by little.

yesNoNote.upright: A difficult time for this. No.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, as things begin to improve.

pentacles-06.name: Six of Pentacles
pentacles-06.upright: Giving and receiving flow in balance. Share what you can, and accept help graciously when it is offered.
pentacles-06.reversed: Generosity may come with strings attached, or the exchange feels one-sided. Look for fairness on both sides.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Support is available.
yesNoNote.reversed: The exchange isn't fair. Not as it stands.

pentacles-07.name: Seven of Pentacles
pentacles-07.upright: Your efforts are growing, though slowly. Pause to assess what is working, and be patient with the harvest.
pentacles-07.reversed: Frustration with slow results may tempt you to give up, or effort is going into the wrong place. Rethink where you invest your energy.

yesNoNote.upright: Possibly, in time. Results are still growing.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not if things stay as they are.

pentacles-08.name: Eight of Pentacles
pentacles-08.upright: Steady, focused work builds real skill. Commit to the details and take pride in improving your craft.
pentacles-08.reversed: Perfectionism or a lack of focus may stall your progress. Work smarter, and remember why the effort matters to you.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, through steady work.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not without more focused effort.

pentacles-09.name: Nine of Pentacles
pentacles-09.upright: Your hard work pays off in comfort and independence. Enjoy what you have built, and take pride in your self-reliance.
pentacles-09.reversed: Comfort may be covering a sense of emptiness, or independence feels shaky. Ask what kind of security you really want.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Your efforts are rewarded.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, but check your footing first.

pentacles-10.name: Ten of Pentacles
pentacles-10.upright: Lasting stability and a legacy built over time. Family, community, and long-term foundations support you.
pentacles-10.reversed: Disagreements over family, home, or shared resources unsettle things. Focus on what truly lasts rather than appearances.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. A stable, lasting outcome.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not while foundations are disputed.

pentacles-11.name: Page of Pentacles
pentacles-11.upright: A chance to learn or start something practical. Approach it like a student: curious, patient, and willing to put in the work.
pentacles-11.reversed: Procrastination or a lack of follow-through holds back a good idea. Set a small, concrete step and take it.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, if you are willing to learn as you go.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not without more commitment.

pentacles-12.name: Knight of Pentacles
pentacles-12.upright: Slow and steady wins. Keep showing up and doing the work; reliability will get you where you want to be.
pentacles-12.reversed: Routine has turned into a rut, or caution has become stubbornness. Shake things up enough to keep moving.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes, but slowly and steadily.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, if you get unstuck.

pentacles-13.name: Queen of Pentacles
pentacles-13.upright: Practical care and a warm home create a sense of security. Look after yourself and others in down-to-earth ways.
pentacles-13.reversed: You may be overextending yourself for others or neglecting your own comfort. Balance caring for others with caring for yourself.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. Practical care brings good results.
yesNoNote.reversed: Possibly, once you tend to your own needs.

pentacles-14.name: King of Pentacles
pentacles-14.upright: Discipline and good judgment create lasting abundance. You are in a position to provide, lead, and enjoy the results of your work.
pentacles-14.reversed: A focus on status or control may crowd out what matters. Success means little if it comes at the cost of your values.

yesNoNote.upright: Yes. A secure, successful outcome.
yesNoNote.reversed: Not if it compromises your values.
